# Business idea validation — stages

<!-- Generated by scripts/package/render_roles.py from workflow.yaml. -->

Decide whether an idea is worth pursuing by discovering the problem, grading evidence, assessing the opportunity, modelling the business and defining validation experiments with kill criteria, reviewed independently and decided by a human.

**Trigger:** A user wants a go, test-first, pivot or stop decision on a business idea.
